Contract version: `1.0`

The `package-runner` category defines 2 capabilities: 1 required and 1 optional. An adapter implementing this category must provide every required capability; a command that needs an optional capability the resolved adapter lacks uses the capability's fallback when one is named.

| Capability | Required | Side effect | Inputs | Outputs | Fallback | Added in minor | Description |

### package-runner.install
